title: Grouping Living Things
seo_title: Foundation Science: Grouping Living Things Worksheets (Australian Curriculum)
standard_text: Observe external features of plants and animals and describe ways they can be grouped based on these features (Australian Curriculum v9.0 Science content description).
meta_desc: Free Foundation science worksheets on grouping living things: living or not living, birds, fish, mammals and insects, what animals eat, and sorting by features. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Sort living things by what you see.
key_sub: Animals with the same features go in the same group, such as fur, feathers or fins.
body_html:
How to think about it

We can sort living things into groups.

  • Living things grow, eat and breathe.
  • Birds have feathers; fish have fins.
  • Mammals have fur; insects have 6 legs.
Example

A kookaburra: which group?

it has feathers

Answer: birds

Common mistakes

  • Calling a whale a fish (it is a mammal).
  • Calling a bat a bird (it is a mammal with fur).
